facts.fact: UCC says licensed operators must pay 2% of gross annual revenue, half remitted to the Consolidated Fund and the rest retained for the Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund (UCUSAF), and on 18 May 2026 Airtel Uganda handed UCC a cheque for UGX 42.9 billion, up from UGX 37.9 billion; the document gives no spending figure and does not cite the Act's section.
